reviews.title: Worst customer service
reviews.text: There is no way of reaching customer service for Jeju air from the USA via phone and if I try the chat, they’re never available. Their airplanes are so small and don’t even provide free movies or a screen at all. All food and water has to be separately paid for. Worst airline I’ve EVER flown with!!
reviews.author: Clair

reviews.title: Outdated covid checks
reviews.text: Not sure why they are asking for so many requirements at the boarding gate? I hold a Philippine passport and the flight was bound for Manila. They asked for (1) my vaccination card (2) my etravel QR code and even asked me to verify what my full name was… Very strange given Philippines already relaxed travel requirements. But i guess thats what i get for booking a low cost carrier.
reviews.author: JVP

reviews.title: Angry with their deceptive practices
reviews.text: Travelling with my significant other came 2h early to be told they have no adjoining seats. The rest of our group (under the same reservation) came 15 minutes later to get 4 adjoining seats. 0/10 stars.
reviews.author: belgradebc

reviews.title: Diverted
reviews.text: The plane was diverted from Busan to Incheon due to bad weather. After going through customs and waiting it was over 3 hours before a bus arrived to take us to the original destination. Each time we asked it was ‘20 minutes away’ so this meant no time to grab food. The journey on a bus then took over 5 hours with no bathroom on it. Including over 2 hour flight that was 10 hours with no food. Terrible experience! Avoid this airline
reviews.author: Matt C

reviews.title: Jeju Airlines is a Dishonest Airline
reviews.text: First, they lost our luggage. Then, they couldn’t find it for three weeks. To this day, they (still) will not reimburse us for expenses we incurred, in accordance with the Montreal Convention, which they are a part of. This past December, my daughter and I flew United Airlines from SFO to Seoul, Korea (where Jeju Airlines is based). At the gate in Seoul, the Jeju Airlines agent told us that our checked bags would not make the flight, but assured us that they would “be on the same flight tomorrow.” The next day came, and we didn’t get our luggage. Over the next three weeks, I called Jeju Airlines support in Seoul 24 times. They had exactly one agent who spoke English. While she was very nice, she could not help much. She had no information about where our bags were. Did they make it onto the flight from SFO? Were they in Seoul? Were they in Manila? She had no idea and could not find out. Jeju Airlines did not know where our bags were for three weeks (I did speak with United Airlines as well). In the meantime, since we had no clothes over the holidays, my daughter and I had to go out and buy necessities. We kept all receipts - and we kept it minimal. We finally received our baggage in the second week of January - three weeks later. Jeju Airlines offered us a total reimbursement of $275 - well below the costs we incurred to replace the lost items ($2,653). I have read the terms of the Montreal Convention thoroughly and consulted an attorney. The Montreal Convention states reimbursable amounts of up to $1731. peer passenger Jeju Airlines refuses to pay us fairly for our expenses and now ignores my requests. Jeju Airlines is in violation of the Montreal Convention. It is disappointing that the airline has chosen to ignore our case, hoping we will give up. They operate without integrity for doing what is right for their customer.
reviews.author: Robert F

reviews.title: Sad and frustrated and angry
reviews.text: I was shocked when the lady at the jeju counter said we were over the limit on our luggages. First time to encounter. We came from America stoped by Korea to visit and enjoy their country for a few days then boarding for philippines i had to pay $600 for excess luggage, Had no choice can’t throw away gifts for my relatives.
reviews.author: Armonia T

reviews.title: Check in
reviews.text: You have an outstanding employee by the name Ms. Nam, Yu Rim. She went above and beyond in assisting me with the Covid application required for me to enter the Philippines. She demonstrated patience, knowledge and dedication to her job and service to the customer. She is one of a kind in the customer service business. Jeju Air should be very proud of her. Thank you for having an employee as Ms. Nam.
reviews.author: NEAL F

reviews.title: Not Great
reviews.text: No Food at all on a 6hr trip. Baggage excess charges are hefty plus they don't speak good english. Only pick as the last option.
reviews.author: Mr Anonymous

reviews.title: Lousy JejuAir
reviews.text: What a lousy airline! A terrible rating is an over-rating. Completely chaotic and long queues at check-in JejuAir counters. Slow check-in procedures take hours. Express/ self check-ins are missing/ a myth. Instructions are broadcast in Korean and not English, making it a narrow Korea airline looking to serve only its compatriots. Why such an airline has not been relegated in these times is shocking! JejuAir, time to wake up or get out.
reviews.author: KH_NG

reviews.title: Comfortable flight to Jeju
reviews.text: My flight with AirAsia to Incheon was delayed, uncomfortable and packed. I was expecting another unpleasant flight to my destination in Jeju. It was a blustery stormy and snowing at the Jeju airport when the flight arrives but the flight through out was smooth. The cabin was surprisingly spacious and comfortable. I was able to choose my seat online. The flight out was also efficient and fast at check in, counter and during flight. I will definitely choose JejuAir for my next trip to Jeju Island.
reviews.author: Anne_Rugby

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.text: Away and return flights departed on time. No free meals and drinks (as mentioned during the booking process) Self assigning seats costs only a couple of dollars but is worth it. Clean and well maintained cabins with average legspace. No inflight entertainment present. On the returnflight the groundstaff at Saipan was very helpfull and managed to label our luggage through all the way to Amsterdam. By the way, luggage is free up to 30KG. A big sellingpoint to me. I would book again with this airline. Such a better flight than the last year with Asiana.
reviews.author: Marcel H

reviews.title: Jeju needs to work on some things
reviews.text: 1. Check-in took too long. They had ONLY ONE agent doing it, and she had about 125-150 people to process. Another agent was next to her, but she was involved with something else. We were in the middle and it took over an hour to get cleared. 2. I would have used their app, but it's not in any other language but Korean. Second, it apparently doesn't allow you to download boarding passes — or so I was told by another Jeju rep. That should be fixed immediately. 3. Last on the check-in, the kiosk wouldn't print boarding passes for people with long names. Again, I was told this by the same agent. The whole check-in process needs attention. 4. Our flight was on a 737, and I've never experienced legroom that tight. I know the plane can be configured to the specs of the individual airline, and Jeju has apparently made it at the bare minimum. The tray table, when lowered, was not adjustable, and gave precious little room. If the passenger in front had their seat reclined, they'd just about be in your food. My guess is that Jeju can't fix this, and it will impact my decision whether to fly them again. Low-cost carriers need to make an effort to please their customers. Just offering a discount fare isn't enough. Vueling is the best I've ever seen. Ryanair is at the other end of the spectrum, and I'll never fly them again. Jeju needs to work harder. They're generally pleasant and wish to be helpful. Now, they have to find ways to be better.
reviews.author: TravelTruth

reviews.title: Inconsistent information - lazy staff
reviews.text: I was told that I can be escorted by JejuAir staff to immigration so that i can go sightseeing and return in the evening for my flight, but the Jeju staff refused. I was also told that my K ETA would not be approved on same day but it was approved in less than an hour. First and last time to fly this airline.
reviews.author: AsianPilgrim3

reviews.title: DO NOT book with these guys unless you are Korean
reviews.text: Now first off, I understand being early to a flight is important, but we were delayed in getting to the express train to the airport due to rush hour in myeong-dong. We made it to the airport at around 7:15 and our flight was at 8:10. Since we weren’t there an hour before they said we couldn’t check in. We had so much time to manually check in and get our baggage on board, but it was a combined NO from all the workers. Not a single worker seemed to want to work there/help anybody. Every single worker I talked to gave me short-breathed replies. Not a single ounce of help. We were out of money to book another ticket and knowing this situation, still did not give one sliver of care. It felt like I was talking to a robot who’s only reply was “no” now don’t be fooled by the title, we made it on our flight to Seoul; our flight back home was the problem. Being stranded in a foreign country and having no help from the airline you paid to trust? The worst possible situation. They didn’t even attempt to do anything. So would I recommend to fly with these guys? Well, in the words of jeju air employees, “no” I would give this airline a negative infinite amount of stars if I could. I know about Korean culture, but this felt like every rude character from a K Drama worked in one airline.
reviews.author: Christopher Reyes

reviews.title: curse them to bankrupt
reviews.text: Super annoying staff they make us feel terrible check in with them. Never going to fly again with them.
reviews.author: Shahby K

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: Don‘t take a long distance trip with this Airline if you‘re not Korean. If you have to, bring your own food and powerbank. They don’t offer any kind of free snack, and when we wanted to buy food, none of our three credit and two debit cards worked, leaving us with nothing to eat for six hours. The flight attendant couldn‘t have cared less and was of no help at all. Also, there are no plugs so you can‘t charge your phone either.
reviews.author: Lena

reviews.title: Baggage transfer
reviews.text: I'd like to compliment the gate agents and ground crew in assisting my wife and on September 1st on flt#2308 .We'd been given some misinformation at the information ticket kiosk located just outside the customs area in regards to having our transferred to our next flight. Im a recently retired flight attendant/ service manager from AA and flew international for 46 years and was always aware that transiting passengers must claim their luggage before boarding the next flight. The information desk assured us thar our baggage would be transferred automatically and made a call to Jeju to assure the bags would be transferred, however 30 minuets prior to the flight we were told that we hadn't claimed our luggage and would have to stay until the the next departure onthe following day. I explained what the information had provided us and was quite upset. However your staff went beyond measure and said only one piece might arrive which was my wifes. However upon our arrival in Manila both pieces had arrived and delivered to us at hlthe baggage carasal. Thank you the extraordinary service. It was greatly appreciated. Sincerely, Timothy Johnson
reviews.author: timmiej

reviews.title: Welps
reviews.text: I didn’t read these reviews until AFTER my arrival to Jeju and I already booked for a flight to Busan via this airline as well. It is narrow and the seatbelts are shorter than usual compared to bigger airlines, so I had to ask for an extender. However, the staff always treated my friend and with Kindness. We’re both Black Women. Even when we had issues understanding something on our way to Busan, a staff from the airline cleared up any misunderstandings kindly. Besides the narrow rows and no leg room ( I’m 5’9 ) it was a decent flight.
reviews.author: KiWil

reviews.title: Worst service
reviews.text: They only catered korean passengers and ingnored me the whole time. I asked a couple questions and just shrugged at me. Very impolite. Will never recommend this airlines at all
reviews.author: Don Ponay

reviews.title: Didn't let me board the flight
reviews.text: They didn't let me check in on Friday and turned me down saying I need a Korean passport to do so. They wouldn't explain anything, had to wait until Monday to be able to call their English helpline, an agent told me that they switched their commercial flights and all existing bookings to special flights, with no cancellations or notifications to their non-Korean customers. Very unprofessional, life-changing to the worst. If they were decent enough to send me an update, I would have booked my essential flight with someone else or used Japan for transit.
reviews.author: Sam

reviews.title: Wouldn't let me on the plane
reviews.text: Wouldn't let me on the plane and refused to issue me a ticket at the gate because I didn't check-in at the counter OUTSIDE of the airport when I was having a transit. I flew from Toronto and was having a 5hrs transit in Seoul to go to Hanoi. I didn't have a visa to even enter the country, how could I go through custom to get my tickets and go through security again???? Staff was super rude when trying to talk to me, felt like she was talking down on me.
reviews.author: LinhN

reviews.title: Uncomfortable and many hidden fees
reviews.text: Flight seats were horribly uncomfortable, the extra leg room I paid for wasn’t actually extra legroom. No food or drinks included. Wouldn’t recommend. Just as bad as airasia.
reviews.author: Joel Gray

reviews.title: Racist Staff and offended customer
reviews.text: Do not fly this airlines unless you from korea. I flew from seoul gimpo to busan and the staff in check in counter refuse to give me receipt/tag checked baggage and asked me wait for 5 mins(i understand that this is cumpulsory for xray baggage). What make me feel racist and feel offended was, all the korean passengers have checked baggage and they believed them and just gave them the receipt tag without hesitation. Just because im not holding korean passport(im singaporean) and they dont believe me. Racist!
reviews.author: Junki L

reviews.title: Flat out hosed me out of 350 dollars
reviews.text: Don't trust, no service, don't operate like western airlines extra sneaky restrictions designed to steal your money
reviews.author: Joseph M

reviews.title: Not bad for a budget airline, Plane was old but clean and tidy
reviews.text: Took off from Osaka approx 20 minutes late, we were informed due to late arrival of the aircraft form Busan. We found out why as we descended towards Busan and were on final approach. The aircraft was really thrown around by cross winds that were coming from all directions, pilot aborted the first approach and a second approach, people were screaming and my wife had to use the sick bag... I fly a lot and I admit I was nervous. We ended up landing 400 odd kilometers away at Muan airport. We were bussed 4 hours back to Gimhae. Weather was atrocious. All that said the weather is no faultof Jeju air and the first part of the journey was smooth without drama. Cabin crew very polite and attentive. I would certainly have no issues flying with them again.
reviews.author: Graham

reviews.title: Horrible air line
reviews.text: Horrible air line! My wife and I were extremely disappointed with the service at Hahn Air Systems (JEJUair), beginning with they are not listed on the ramp so our taxi driver couldn't find it. They limited the suitcases to 1 per person with a maximum weight of 15 kg, and for an extra bag which weighted exactly 15 kg the charged us the outrage amount of $195.00 US dollars. In top of this they make us buy a return ticket more expensive than the one we bought from you, $309.00 US dollars, claiming that immigration in Taiwan will ask for it, and they never did as I told them they wouldn't since I had lived in Taiwan and showed them my expired Taiwanese residence. In addition, the girl at the counter provide and awful service, unprofessional, we believe she should not be working facing the public as well as the supervisor they even laugh multiple time at our predicament. After paying the $504 USD extra we finally did our check-in, then we were asked by the supervisor to sit and wait for 3-5 minutes for our luggage inspection. That wait took longer and suddenly, just 5 minutes before our gate closed, a young lady from Jejuair appears to rush us to the security entrance saying that we were late, even though we got to the airport 2 h and 30 min ahead of our departure time. The stewardess were not welcoming and just gave us a half cup of water after we asked for it, on a three hours flight. A for entertainment, food or drink services, there were not offered at all. Jejuair is not a recommended airline to be taken by anyone. To put the ice on the cake it is imposible to find a email address where to claim refund for a ticket or a costumer service. Sincerely, Victor Garrido, MD
reviews.author: VGP

reviews.title: Low costs as taking bus
reviews.text: Low costs , just like taking a bus, sleep thru out whole trip , no need to wake for air meals. anyway, Can't understand ppl expect full serve in short haul, you can eat at anywhere much better than the air meal, and spend ur time with ur phone or movie..
reviews.author: littleyinglittle

reviews.title: Excellent Service and Unbeatable Prices
reviews.text: One of the great things about Jeju Air is that they are technically a budget airline but they don't skimp on anything. The ticket prices dropped recently for flights leaving Korea to Japan. I took advantage of this a couple of times. The quality of service was great and the staff was happy, friendly and helpful.
reviews.author: Jason Teale

reviews.title: The Spirit Airlines of Asia
reviews.text: Terrible!!!!!!!!! Economy or not, they are below standards of even other "budget" airlines worldwide. First, I flew from Korea to Japan. That's an *international flight*, which usually has a limit of 23kg for luggage. Not Jeju, they put it at 15kg. (For my fellow American travelers, imagine if Southwest changed their limit from 50lbs to 30lbs. Bogus.) What the f#@$ ?! That's even lower than the 20kg that other domestic flights in Asia set it at (for example, in China, Japan). So how is the price so cheap? They screw you on your luggage. Just to give you context, I'm on a three-week business trip in the middle of winter. That means sweaters, jackets, bulky clothes. A large, long-term-trip suitcase is standard to fit 23kg/50lbs. This is my first warning for foreigners who are taking long trips! Second, there was absolutely no way to check in online or even with the app. I was ok when I got to Incheon airport at the kiosk, but I was one of the lucky ones. I saw another group of foreigners who couldn't even use the kiosk. The Jeju website and app are absolute crap for this. Third, they made up bogus rules to not let me bring an already paid for coffee on board. "No hot drinks allowed." Sorry, but that's bull. **No airline ever has *ever* told me that.** Moreover, there's no law or regulation that states this, or else ALL airlines would be telling us this! (My flight experience is including in the US, Europe, and Asia.) So I had to chug down my hot coffee before I boarded the flight. Fourth, all they give you is water. This is how I decided to title my review. It is just like Spirit airlines in the US, and that's just sad. Fifth, they were too inept to check my luggage all the way to my final destination (my next legs of the trip switched to Japan airlines). So I had to get my luggage and check in all over again, go through security again, etc. Good thing I had a long enough layover in Osaka. Again, keep in mind I'm a seasoned traveler and I've had to fly multiple airlines for work before, none of which, were too incompetent to check luggage all the way through. If you're hard up on cash, by all means, fly this crap airline, but you're probably going to pay the same fare as a regular airline if you want to bring regular luggage and eat/drink anything besides water on board. Also keep in mind I didn't choose this airline. It was booked by work. On the plus side, now I know to avoid it at all costs.
reviews.author: Stephanie S

reviews.title: Typical low-cost carrier, questionable customer service
reviews.text: Flight was ok, typical low-cost carrier. Flight was moved forward from 1035am to 0830 am - info on that was distributed by a single email in korean and japanese languages that landed in the spam folder. Fortunately I saw it there by chance and did not miss the flight.
reviews.author: B S

reviews.title: Review on my flight with Jeju Air
reviews.text: Took Jeju Air from Cebu on Oct 31st and return flight was Nov 3rd. Flight was full. It was a 4+ hours flight. Nary a small snack or water offered. Would have been okay but it was too warm inside the cabin and really uncomfortable, wished they put on the air condition or cooling system. Other passengers also commented on this. I understand it is an economy airline but at least they make their passengers comfortable too.
reviews.author: Lplozada

reviews.title: Affordable Airlines
reviews.text: I took Jeju Air from Seoul (Gimpo Airport) to Jeju just want to try their airlines. Never expected is very convenient like Air Asia. Price affordable and we can choose either without baggage or with baggage (price difference subject want you choose). Price for early morning flight quite expensive compared to evening flight. I chose evening flight since its cheaper and want to save budget (hahah). I'm quite surprised during check in because i can chose any seat i want without any additional charge (first come first serve) and the staff quite helpful too. Everything good really recommended.
reviews.author: hanynuriliana

reviews.title: Jeju Air is the best!
reviews.text: I took Jeju Air by chance so I was not expecting much. I can say I am really impressed. From booking the flight to the arrival is such a delight. Crew are very pleasant. Take off time is very quick as well. They offer very good baggage package and meal package compared to other airlines as well. I have had flown with Jeju Air twice and it the experience just kept getting better.
reviews.author: Helen D

reviews.title: Way better than I expected for such an affordable airline!! :)
reviews.text: We took Jeju Air from Guam to Osaka for vacation and looooved it!I! Booking (tl;dr - book tickets on the APP and not online) : I have to admit, the process of buying tickets was kind of a hassle. I'm not sure if it's like this in all Jeju ticket offices, but the ones on Guam were closed when it said "open", and it was also hard to book tickets on the phone. It's tough to book on the website as well due to some errors and timed out connections (I tried this over 2 weeks on several computers/devices to ensure it wasn't just my browser or device and the same thing occured). BUT, it was very easy on the app. :) So I recommend you skip all these and just book straight on the app! :D Price: We happened to get a promo deal and paid about a total of $650 USD for TWO round trip tickets from Guam - Japan. And this is not even the lowest package option; I chose one with free cancellation/more baggage/and a welcome snack. In any other airline, the price would be $1200 - $2000 USD just for that. :O In-Person Check In: The process is very efficient and like most airline carriers so we had no hassle here :) In-Flight Experience: On the day of our flight, the staff were SO polite and helpful and welcoming. I sprained my knee the DAY of the trip and ended up needing a wheelchair :( they took utmost care of making sure I was okay on the wheelchair, on the plane, and getting off the plane. I booked a package where cancellation was free, but it also came in with 2 checked pieces of baggage and a welcome snack. Let me tell you, those welcome snack boxes are HUGE and can fill you up just like a meal. So much that when our actual ordered meal arrived, we were already full from the snack lol. And they are delicious!! My husband and I both enjoyed the big muffins and orange juice we got going to Osaka, and the yummy tarts going from Osaka to Guam. The seats are also very comfortable, pretty roomy and the overhead bins have significantly larger room/space than most other airlines I've taken...I was shocked at how our checked luggage slid all the way to the back and there was STILL space left in the front. I honestly have to say that the service, seating, food and everything (with the exception of the initial booking process) was actually even better than service I've received from other higher-priced airlines!! And this is a budget airline. I would SOOO take this airline again. Thank you, Jeju Air!!!
reviews.author: Chloe A

reviews.title: Booking with Jeju Air
reviews.text: I have used to Jeju Air when I traveled to Seoul during Golden Week of this year, and booked again for December with a buddy of mine. Cheap and good service especially from Tokyo, cant wait to use their services again!
reviews.author: Dan Sugihara

reviews.title: The best Bibimbap I've ever had at Jeju Air
reviews.text: I am a frequent traveller and I never usually review airlines because for me there is a different experience on each flight whether budget or not. And I never really choose between budget or not because I care more about the time, convenience, distance and location. It was our first time to fly from Tokyo to Seoul and we have several choices and most are very expensive especially the non budget airlines but luckily we found one that's right in our budget and perfect time - Jeju Air. Departing Tokyo at 1810 at Narita's T3 we expect to arrive in Seoul at 2105. It was a full flight and our check-in took around half an hour but it was pretty smooth. The flight is not delayed and we still arrived on time. What caught my attention is their food. Since it's dinner time for us we have to eat. Checking their menu it was extensive - combination of Korean and Western options and many set meals to choose from. I found what I like - Bibimbap only this time it's vegetarian which is ok for me. At 5000 Won (5 USD) what more can I say - it was a miracle. For this price I could only buy chips in other budget airlines. The water is equally cheap - just 2000 Won for a Sparkling water. The Bibimbap is super tasty, fresh and hot off the oven. I finished each and every inch of it. The Gochujang sauce is divine, spicy, salty, sweet and savoury. This dish can easily match 5 star airlines and fine dining restaurants and will win. Hands down the best dish I ever had in any airlines I've tried. I highly recommend Jeju Air when visiting Korea you will have the best Bibimbap dish up in the air. My flight number is 7C1103 - kudos to Jeju air and its flight and crew.
reviews.author: Krubee

reviews.title: Shameful online check in experience
reviews.text: Freaking online check in is a mess. I never thought an airline carrier would have such a bad website or experience. No reaction in many pages, translated only in parts, and very confusing navigation. If the product/IT team is reading this, you have a lot of work to do. The UX is awful and super confusing. It really shouldn't be, please get your website fixed, it is shameful in this digital age to have such an awful check in experience.
reviews.author: XiangorMirko

reviews.title: Региональная авиакомпания Южной Кореи с вполне приемлемым сервисом
reviews.text: It is low cost company, no business class on board. But the distance between chairs quite comfortable. You can choose one from several kind of tariffes: confirmed seat number, with or without luggage, snacks. Flight was in time. Yes, I am satisfied with this flight.
reviews.author: Alexanderfokichev

reviews.title: No Fuss Budget Airline
reviews.text: First time to use a budget airline going to Seoul and I am very happy with Jeju Air's service. In my case, they deserve the best budget air of South Korea. There were no delays, airplane seats are OK, flight attendants were helpful, pre-ordered food was OK, great selection of in flight food, there is inflight sales, and terminal at Seoul is same as the big airlines, so airport service was OK. I will definitely use this airline again.
reviews.author: altair06

reviews.title: Low cost Korean airline
reviews.text: We booked a flight while in Osaka for World Cup. To our surprise the flight was cancelled due to a typhoon in Busan and got to know while we were at the airport. They had sent correspondence but it was in Korean. We were assisted and were accommodated to a flight to Gimpo in Seoul and took a train to from Seoul to Busan. On our return trip we were charged an exorbitant fee for luggage, which was not the case on a previous flight. Otherwise the flight was pleasant
reviews.author: Rhadidi

reviews.title: Orange You Sweet Jeju Air
reviews.text: Great discount airline, not the cheapest but almost. Reliable, friendly people, no hassles, on time flight, straightforward process. Seems more personal than many other discount airlines. Really appreciated English speaking, polite, efficient staff. They seemed really committed to service, just like a good Big Airline. We paid extra for boarding priority and roomier seats, which is almost always a good idea for any flight over 90 minutes. Nice array of destinations, especially regional Korean places, and a generous frequent flyer program. People in the region would do well to hook up with Jeju and explore widely. Seats going from Korea to Japan and vice versa, like our itinerary, must be a particular deal because of Koreans avoiding Japan now. I
reviews.author: VancouverHome

reviews.title: City Airport Terminal in Seoul Station
reviews.text: My fave is you can check in your luggage in Seoul Station. Then take AREX to Incheon. In Incheon Airport there is a special lane for those who already checked in using City Airport Terminal. Also we arrived in Manila ahead of schedule.
reviews.author: Sadicay

reviews.title: Departed late but arrived on time
reviews.text: The travel is smooth. Late boarding, then due to congestion in NAIA did not leave as scheduled. But we still arrived on time in Incheon. cons.. they still dont have Mobile/Web Check in for Manila to Incheon. And long lines for check in counter in NAIA.
reviews.author: Sadicay

reviews.title: Affordable
reviews.text: Budget friendly.on time. Very convenient. Wait for the sale. Friendly staff. Easy to check in. Mobile booking is user friendly
reviews.author: KoryAnne

reviews.title: It’s Mobile APP is a Trap
reviews.text: I registered as member with its App, it disallowed me to input more than 1 word under “Given Name” and there is no place to input my middle names. Tried to buy ticket, no place for middle names. Asked the one-on-one chat with its web-site, the staff said middle names are not needed and can still fly with my first and last names as passenger. So I bought and issued the ticket with only my first and last name. At the airport, I was not allowed to fly without my middle names on the ticket because my first and middle names are together under “given names” on my passport. The staff said “Middle names” means there is a separate field on the passport that says “middle names”. If all under “given names” then all those names must be on the ticket as the passenger’s name. I ended up having to buy another ticket. Tried to refund the original ticket, I had to pay cancellation fee. Tried to file my complaint with the airline, it is like talking to my hand.
reviews.author: JustScreenName

reviews.title: The worst flight ever
reviews.text: When I get off the airplane, I saw that anyone let someone go first even a mom has a baby. Just going their way, do whatever they want. There were like an animal gate... Costomer base is worst.. Seats are too narrow..cabin crew makes me rushing to put my baggage in the cabinet but we can't do it fast because the space is narrow.Even I sit in the first row, a cabin crew put my baggage in the cabinet of 7rows had a too hard time to pick our baggage. Annoying flight ever. The price on the Airseoul is almost same compering with Jeju air but why the quality is totally different... I strongly recommend you to don't use this airplane.
reviews.author: NzNz

reviews.title: Not so Good as Label
reviews.text: The seat is really uncomfortable for the 5 hours trip. The Air-Con did not work properly on the return flight. The whole crew - except Captain - could not understand English.

reviews.title: Nothing to complain
reviews.text: From Seoul to Tokyo I actually experienced the smoothest short-haul flight ever! Compliments to the pilot!
reviews.author: Samantha K

reviews.title: Would not recommend
reviews.text: I booked this airline on skyscanner under the assumption that it had baggage allowance only to notice that it didn’t after the flight was booked. Not a problem because you can pre-book baggage allowance except their website doesn’t work properly and doesn’t allow you to do so I called the customer service centre only to speak to a very unfriendly unhelpful staff The day before my flight I went to the Chiang Mai airport to go to the check in counter there and ask to pre-purchase baggage allowance but they said they were not able to match the online price and the price to purchase is higher Apparently I’m not the only customer with this problem but Jeju air has done nothing about it. Maybe it’s a scheme to get more money out of customers??
reviews.author: Chan Song L

reviews.title: Not one complaint!
reviews.text: I have to say, after booking our tickets and THEN reading reviews I was extremely nervous and was prepared for the worst. Some were saying they had to pay for carryon items that were overweight and for “personal items” (because you’re only allowed 1 carryon item) and I honestly couldn’t find a good answer as to what was allowed no matter how much I googled. Upon arriving at Incheon airport we made our way to the ticket counter and were warmly greeted and got our boarding pass with not a single problem! They didn’t even weigh our backpacks and I questioned if I could take on my “personal item” for free. The answer was “Sure...no problem!” So we each boarded with 2 items...backpacks and purses! We did use the scales to make sure we were within the weight limits of the carryon item just in case. The flight left on time and arrived in Hanoi 15 minutes early with one of the smoothest landings I’ve ever experienced. And the flight attendants were absolutely precious...so friendly, helpful and kind. Thank you Jeju for a wonderful flight and all around great experience!!!!
reviews.author: FlightAttendantMom
